parsed.summary: The patch changes the permission checks for auto-created intermediate models in admin inlines, but it may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch changes the permission checks from 'view' to 'change' for auto-created intermediate models. This may break existing behavior where users with only view permissions could not modify the intermediate model, which might be relied upon in some cases.
